description: This launch, historically. The deployer's record at this launch (launches before it, graduations, the gap to the previous one, launches in the last day), the bundle at creation (buyers in the first 10 s and the share of supply they took), the insiders' share now, curve progress, and how launches that looked the same at this age went over their next 24 h (graduation share, peak and close quantiles, how many died). $0.005 a call, USDC on Solana over x402.

payment.description: the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value for this exact call (USDC on Solana). Leave it out to get the offer: the price, the payee and the network come back as the error content and as _meta['payment-required'].

name: launch_record
